title: TMS-fMRI Brain Tumor Connectivity Mapping (TTC-Map)
summary: Certain brain tumors often continue to grow despite treatment. New research shows that they interact closely with healthy areas of the brain, thereby promoting their growth. The aim is to investigate whether this connection between the tumor and healthy brain tissue can be visualized and specifically targeted. Participants will undergo a special brain examination as well as gentle, non-invasive brain stimulation. During this process, changes in the connection between the tumor and the brain will be measured.

interventions.name: At the start of the study, a baseline MRI (3T) is performed, including structural 3D T1-weighted imaging and resting-state fMRI, to identify suitable target regions for TMS. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with suspected glioma or confirmed glioma (biopsied but not resected), 
as well as patients with suspected cerebral metastases or confirmed metastases (biopsied 
but not resected).
Capacity to give informed consent.
Eligibility for MRI without contraindications.
Exclusion criteria:
An urgent need for neurosurgical intervention due to a mass lesion or brain swelling.
Known pregnancy.
Claustrophobia.
